PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998

Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14 BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 1 : 1, 1 : 2, 1 : 4, 1 : 6, 1 : 7, 1 : 8, 1 : 9, 1 : 10, 1 : 11, 1 : 12, 1 : 13, 1 : 14, 1 : 15, 1 : 16, 1 : 17, 1 : 18, 1 : 19, 1 : 20, 1 : 21, 1 : 22, 1 : 23, 1 : 24, 1 : 26, 1 : 27, 1 : 28, 1 : 29, 1 : 30, 1 : 31, 1 : 32, 1 : 33, 1 : 34, 1 : 35, 1 : 36, 1 : 37, 1 : 38, 1 : 39, 1 : 40, 1 : 41, 1 : 42, 1 : 43, 1 : 45, 1 : 46, 1 : 47, 1 : 48, 1 : 49, 1 : 51, 1 : 52, 1 : 53, 1 : 54 and 1 : 55 of Block 1, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 610528, situated in the Village of Thimbiripola within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 118/D , Thimbiripola in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Dehiovita, in the District of Kegalle, in the Province of Sabaragamuwa, referred to in Notice No. 61/0173 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2338/46 of 29th June, 2023 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. P. C. D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla, 12th December, 2023.
No. 2377/24 – WEDNESDAY, MARCH 27, 2024
